information.step4: Slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position, controlling the movement and keeping your core engaged.

information.step1: Start by placing a stability ball on the floor and position yourself in a high plank position with your feet resting on top of the ball. Ensure your hands are directly under your shoulders and your body forms a straight line.
information.step2: Engage your core muscles and slowly lift your hips towards the ceiling, rolling the stability ball towards your chest.
information.step3: Keep your core engaged and maintain control as you roll the stability ball back to the starting position, extending your body into a high plank.
information.step4: Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.

information.step1: Start in a high plank position with your hands on the medicine ball, directly under your shoulders, and your body forming a straight line from head to heels.
information.step2: Engage your core and lift one foot off the ground, bringing your knee towards your chest, while maintaining your balance on the medicine ball.
information.step3: Quickly switch legs, extending the bent leg back while bringing the other knee towards your chest, still maintaining your balance on the medicine ball.
information.step4: Continue alternating legs in a running motion on the medicine ball, keeping your core tight, maintaining balance, and maintaining a steady pace.

information.step1: Start by placing your hands on the bench and positioning your body in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your feet on the ground.
information.step2: Engage your core and lift one foot off the ground, bringing your knee towards your chest while maintaining a straight line from head to heels.
information.step3: Quickly switch legs, extending the bent leg back while bringing the other knee towards your chest.
information.step4: Continue alternating legs in a running motion, bringing your knees towards your chest on the inclined surface of the bench.

information.step1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Position the barbell at shoulder level.
information.step2: Bend your knees slightly and engage your core muscles. This will provide a small amount of leg drive to help generate momentum for the lift.
information.step3: Explosively extend your legs, driving through your heels and pressing the barbell overhead. Use the momentum from your legs to assist in the upward movement of the barbell.
information.step4: Lock out your arms at the top of the movement, fully extending your elbows. Lower the barbell back down to the starting position with control.

information.step1: Start with a dumbbell on the ground between your feet. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and your back straight.
information.step2: Reach down and grab the dumbbell with an overhand grip, keeping your arm extended and your palm facing your body. This is your starting position.
information.step3: Explosively drive through your heels and extend your legs and hips, simultaneously pulling the dumbbell upwards in a swift, fluid motion.
information.step4: As the dumbbell rises, quickly rotate your hand, flipping your palm to face upwards, and continue pulling the weight overhead. Catch the weight with your arm extended.

information.step1: Set an incline bench to a comfortable angle, typically around 45 degrees. Place a pair of dumbbells on the floor near the head of the bench.
information.step2: Position yourself face down on the incline bench, resting your chest against the top of the bench and allowing your arms to hang down, holding the dumbbells with an overhand grip.
information.step3: Engage your core muscles and squeeze your shoulder blades together as you lift the dumbbells up towards your chest.
information.step4: Slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position, fully extending your arms.

information.step1: Adjust the seat height and handlebar position to fit your body comfortably.
information.step2: Sit on the bike and place your feet on the pedals. Hold onto the handlebars with a comfortable grip.
information.step3: Begin pedaling the bike by pushing down with your feet and pulling up with your arms. The harder and faster you pedal, the more resistance you'll experience from the air fan.
information.step4: To increase the intensity of your workout, pedal faster or increase the resistance level on the bike.

information.step1: Start in a high plank position with your hands holding a pair of dumbbells, each hand resting on the ground directly under your shoulders. Your feet should be shoulder-width apart, and your body forming a straight line from head to heels.
information.step2: Engage your core and glutes to keep your body stable as you lift one dumbbell off the ground, rowing it up towards your chest while keeping your elbow close to your body.
information.step3: Lower the dumbbell back down to the ground, maintaining your plank position.
information.step4: Repeat the rowing motion on the other side, lifting the opposite dumbbell off the ground.

information.step1: Start in a high plank position with your hands holding a pair of dumbbells, each hand resting on the ground directly under your shoulders.
information.step2: Your feet should be shoulder-width apart, and your body forming a straight line from head to heels.
information.step3: Engage your core and glutes to keep your body stable as you lift one dumbbell off the ground, rowing it up towards your chest while keeping your elbow close to your body.
information.step4: Lower the dumbbell back down to the ground, then perform a push-up by bending your elbows and lowering your chest towards the ground.

information.step1: Stand inside the trap bar with feet shoulder-width apart. Grip the handles with palms facing inwards.
information.step2: Keep back flat and chest lifted. Hinge at hips and bend knees to lower and grasp the handles fully.
information.step3: Engage core, lift the trap bar by driving through heels and straightening hips and knees.
information.step4: Lower trap bar back down with control. Repeat for desired reps, focusing on form and engaging leg and back muscles.

information.step1: Stand inside the trap bar with your feet shoulder-width apart. Grip the handles with palms facing inwards.
information.step2: Keep your chest lifted, engage your core, and lower your body by bending your knees and pushing your hips back, maintaining a neutral spine.
information.step3: Squat down until your thighs are parallel to the ground or as low as you can comfortably go, while keeping your knees in line with your toes.
information.step4: Push through your heels and engage your leg muscles to return to the starting position.

name: Renegade Rows With Push Ups V2

information.step1: Start in a high plank position with hands on dumbbells.
information.step2: Perform a row with one dumbbell, then lower it to the ground.
information.step3: Do a push-up, then return to the plank position.
information.step4: Alternate rows and push-ups with each arm. Focus on control and engaging your core.

information.step1: Stand inside the trap bar with your feet shoulder-width apart. Grip the handles with your palms facing your body.
information.step2: Keep your back straight and chest lifted. Lift the trap bar by straightening your hips and knees, focusing on using your leg muscles.
information.step3: Once you've fully extended your hips and knees, lift your shoulders as high as possible by shrugging them towards your ears.
information.step4: Lower your shoulders back down and then lower the trap bar by bending your hips and knees. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, focusing on engaging your leg and shoulder muscles during the movement. Adjust the weight as needed.

information.step1: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand by your sides.
information.step2: Keep your back straight and your chest lifted. Relax your arms and shoulders.
information.step3: Lift your shoulders as high as possible by shrugging them towards your ears.
information.step4: Lower your shoulders back down and repeat the shrug for the desired number of repetitions. Focus on engaging your shoulder muscles and maintaining proper form throughout the movement.

information.step1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
information.step2: Keep your back straight and chest lifted. Relax your arms and shoulders.
information.step3: Lift your shoulders as high as possible by shrugging them towards your ears.
information.step4: Lower your shoulders back down and repeat the shrug for the desired number of repetitions. Focus on engaging your shoulder muscles and maintaining proper form throughout the movement. Adjust the weight as needed.

information.step1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in each hand by your sides.
information.step2: Keep your back straight and chest lifted. Relax your arms and shoulders.
information.step3: Lift your shoulders as high as possible by shrugging them towards your ears.
information.step4: Lower your shoulders back down and repeat the shrug for the desired number of repetitions. Focus on engaging your shoulder muscles and maintaining proper form throughout the movement. Adjust the weight as needed.

information.step1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell behind your back with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
information.step2: Keep your back straight and chest lifted. Relax your arms and shoulders.
information.step3: Lift your shoulders as high as possible by shrugging them towards your ears.
information.step4: Lower your shoulders back down and repeat the shrug for the desired number of repetitions. Focus on engaging your shoulder muscles and maintaining proper form throughout the movement. Adjust the weight as needed.

information.step1: Stand inside the Smith machine with your feet shoulder-width apart. Position the barbell of the Smith machine behind your back at hip level.
information.step2: Hold the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Keep your back straight and chest lifted.
information.step3: Lift your shoulders as high as possible by shrugging them towards your ears.
information.step4: Lower your shoulders back down and repeat the shrug for the desired number of repetitions. Focus on engaging your shoulder muscles and maintaining proper form throughout the movement. Adjust the weight as needed.

information.step1: Sit on a bench with back support, holding a dumbbell in each hand by your sides.
information.step2: Keep your back straight and chest lifted.
information.step3: Lift your shoulders as high as possible by shrugging them towards your ears.
information.step4: Lower your shoulders back down and repeat the shrug for the desired number of repetitions, focusing on engaging your shoulder muscles and maintaining proper form throughout the movement. Adjust the weight as needed.

information.step1: Stand inside the Smith machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
information.step2: Position the barbell of the Smith machine at thigh level.
information.step3: Hold the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
information.step4: Lift your shoulders as high as possible by shrugging them towards your ears, then lower them back down. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, focusing on engaging your shoulder muscles and maintaining proper form throughout the movement. Adjust the weight as needed.

information.step1: Sit on a bench with back support, or on a chair, with your feet flat on the floor.
information.step2: Hold a barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart, holding it under your thighs.
information.step3: Keep your back straight and chest lifted.
information.step4: Lift your shoulders as high as possible by shrugging them towards your ears while holding the barbell. Lower your shoulders back down and repeat the shrug for the desired number of repetitions, focusing on engaging your shoulder muscles and maintaining proper form throughout the movement. Adjust the weight as needed.

information.step1: Stand in front of the plate loaded shrug machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
information.step2: Adjust the machine to your desired height and load the appropriate weight plates onto it.
information.step3: Grasp the handles or grips provided with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
information.step4: Lift your shoulders as high as possible by shrugging them towards your ears while holding the machine's handles or grips. Lower your shoulders back down and repeat the shrug for the desired number of repetitions, focusing on engaging your shoulder muscles and maintaining proper form throughout the movement. Adjust the weight as needed.

information.step1: Set an incline bench to a comfortable angle, typically around 30 to 45 degrees.
information.step2: Lay on the incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, resting your chest on the upright pad and feet planted for support. Let the dumbbells hang.
information.step3: Lift your shoulders as high as possible by shrugging them towards your ears while holding the dumbbells.
information.step4: Lower your shoulders back down and repeat the shrug for the desired number of repetitions, focusing on engaging your shoulder muscles and maintaining proper form throughout the movement. Adjust the weight as needed.

information.step1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand by your side.
information.step2: Keep your back straight and chest lifted.
information.step3: Lift your shoulder on the side with the dumbbell as high as possible by shrugging it towards your ear.
information.step4: Lower your shoulder back down and repeat the shrug for the desired number of repetitions. Focus on engaging your shoulder muscles and maintaining proper form throughout the movement. Switch to the other arm and repeat for balanced training. Adjust the weight as needed.

information.step1: Set up the Prowler Sled: Load the sled with the desired amount of weight. Adjust the handles to a comfortable height for pushing.
information.step2: Proper Stance: Stand behind the Prowler with your feet shoulder-width apart. Bend at your hips and knees to lower your body into a squatting position. Grip the handles with your hands, keeping them at about chest height.
information.step3: Push the Sled: Push the Prowler sled forward by extending your hips and knees explosively. Keep your back straight and maintain a strong core as you drive the sled forward. Use powerful strides and maintain a brisk pace.
information.step4: Pushing and Repetitions: Continue pushing the sled for the desired distance or time, making sure to maintain good form throughout. Keep a consistent and controlled pace. When finished, carefully stop the sled and step away.

information.step1: Set Up: Adjust the decline ab bench to your desired angle. Secure your feet at the top end of the bench.
information.step2: Lie Back: Position yourself on the bench with your upper body reclined. Cross your arms over your chest or place your hands behind your head.
information.step3: Crunch Up: Exhale as you lift your upper body off the bench by contracting your abdominal muscles. Keep your neck neutral and focus on using your abs to lift.
information.step4: Lower Down: Inhale as you slowly lower your upper body back to the starting position. Control the movement throughout. Repeat for your desired number of reps.

information.step1: Set Up the Tank Sled: Load the tank sled with the desired amount of weight plates or resistance. Make sure the sled is on a flat, stable surface.
information.step2: Grasp the Handles: Stand behind the tank sled and grip the handles with both hands, keeping them at a comfortable height.
information.step3: Push the Sled: Start pushing the tank sled forward by driving your legs and engaging your core. Keep your back straight and maintain a strong posture throughout the movement.
information.step4: Pushing and Repetitions: Continue pushing the tank sled for the desired distance or time. Focus on maintaining a steady and controlled pace, and use your legs, hips, and upper body strength to propel the sled forward.

information.step1: Set Up: Load the appropriate weight onto the T-Bar row machine. Place it in a suitable location, ensuring it's secure and won't tip over.
information.step2: Stance: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent. You'll be bending at the hips, so keep your back straight.
information.step3: Grip the Handles: Reach down and grasp the handles or the T-Bar attachment of the machine with both hands. Your hands should be slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
information.step4: Row: Exhale as you pull the handles or T-Bar attachment toward your lower ribcage, squeezing your shoulder blades together at the peak of the movement. Keep your back straight, chest up, and core engaged. Inhale as you slowly extend your arms and return the handles to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining proper form and control throughout.

information.step1: Stand in Front of the Ski Erg: Position yourself in front of the Ski Erg machine, ensuring your feet are hip-width apart.
information.step2: Hold the Handles: Grasp the handles of the Ski Erg with both hands, and maintain an overhand grip (palms facing down). Your arms should be extended, and your body should be in an upright position.
information.step3: Begin the Skiing Motion: Initiate the skiing motion by pushing the handles downward while simultaneously bending at your hips and knees. As you push down with one hand, the other hand should be rising upward.
information.step4: Alternate Arms and Legs: Continue the skiing motion by alternating the pushing and pulling of the handles with your arms while bending and extending your legs. Imagine you're cross-country skiing, and maintain a fluid, rhythmic motion.

information.step1: Set Up: Adjust the seat and footpad of the leg extension machine to your desired settings. Load an appropriate weight plate onto the machine.
information.step2: Position: Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet securely positioned under the footpad. Make sure your knees are aligned with the machine's pivot point.
information.step3: Execution: Extend one leg fully, pushing against the footpad while keeping your back against the backrest. Exhale as you perform this extension. Keep your movement controlled and avoid using momentum.
information.step4: Return: Inhale as you slowly lower the weight by bending your knee, returning to the starting position. Maintain control throughout the movement. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions on one leg before switching to the other.

information.step1: Set Up: Adjust the foot straps on the rowing machine so that they securely hold your feet in place. Adjust the resistance level to your preference, with lower settings for less resistance and higher settings for more resistance.
information.step2: Start Position: Sit on the rowing machine's seat, ensuring your feet are securely strapped in. Grab the handlebar with an overhand grip, keeping your arms fully extended and your back straight. Your knees should be bent, and your shins should be vertical.
information.step3: Rowing Stroke: The Catch — push off with your legs, extending them fully while keeping your arms straight. The Drive — lean back slightly as your legs straighten, engaging your leg and back muscles. The Finish — pull the handlebar toward your lower ribs. The Recovery — extend your arms, lean forward at the hips, then bend your knees to slide back to the catch.
information.step4: Row Continuously: Repeat the rowing stroke, moving smoothly between the catch, drive, finish, and recovery positions. Maintain a steady pace and rhythm, focusing on proper technique and using your legs, core, and arms in coordination.

information.step1: Set Up: Adjust the height of the machine's platform to match your body height. Ensure that the weight stack or loading mechanism is set to the desired resistance level.
information.step2: Attach the Belt: Put on the provided belt or harness and secure it around your waist. Make sure it's snug but not uncomfortably tight.
information.step3: Stand on the Platform: Step onto the machine's platform with your feet shoulder-width apart. Position yourself so that the weight stack is between your legs and the belt is securely attached to your waist.
information.step4: Squat and Return: Initiate the squat by bending at your hips and knees, keeping your back straight and core engaged. Lower yourself until your thighs are parallel to the ground, then push through your heels to extend your hips and knees back to standing.

information.step1: Set Up: Adjust the seat height and handlebar position to your comfort. Set the desired resistance level using the damper setting.
information.step2: Mount the BikeErg: Straddle the bike and place your feet on the pedals. Adjust the foot straps if equipped.
information.step3: Begin Cycling: Start pedaling in a smooth and controlled motion. You can choose between various programs or simply ride at your own pace.
information.step4: Monitor Stats: Keep an eye on the monitor for information like speed, distance, time, and resistance level. Adjust your workout intensity as desired.

information.step1: Set Up: Position a flat bench in front of the Jammer Arms machine. Adjust the height of the Jammer Arms handles to your preference and load the machine with the desired weight plates.
information.step2: Lie Down: Lie flat on the bench with your upper back and shoulders resting on the bench. Position your body so that the handles of the Jammer Arms are directly above your chest.
information.step3: Grip and Press: Reach up and grip the handles of the Jammer Arms with both hands, palms facing down. Push the handles away from your chest, extending your arms fully while keeping your back and head on the bench.
information.step4: Return to Starting Position: Slowly lower the handles back towards your chest by bending your elbows, allowing them to come down to chest level or slightly below. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

information.step1: Set Up: Adjust the Jammer Arms machine to your desired settings, including the height of the handles and the weight plates.
information.step2: Stand and Grip: Stand in front of the Jammer Arms machine, with your feet shoulder-width apart. Reach for the handles with both hands, gripping them firmly at shoulder height or slightly above.
information.step3: Press Overhead: Push the handles upward and overhead while extending your arms fully. Keep your core engaged, back straight, and feet planted on the ground.
information.step4: Lower and Repeat: Lower the handles back down to shoulder height or slightly below, bending your elbows. Repeat the press for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining control and proper form throughout the exercise.

information.step1: Secure one end of the resistance band to a stable object, like a bench at head level.
information.step2: Position yourself on your back with your head near the anchor point, knees bent, and feet flat.
information.step3: Hold the other end of the resistance band beside your ears with both hands, elbows out.
information.step4: Exhale as you lift your head, neck, and shoulders off the ground using your core muscles. Keep your hands near your ears.

information.step1: Place the resistance band on the ground and step on it with both feet, ensuring your feet are hip-width or shoulder-width apart.
information.step2: Grasp the handles of the resistance band with both hands, palms facing your body, and your arms hanging down at your sides.
information.step3: Keeping your arms straight, exhale as you lift both arms out to the sides until they are at shoulder level or slightly below.
information.step4: Inhale as you slowly lower your arms back down to your sides, returning to the starting position.

information.step1: Step on the resistance band with both feet, hip-width apart.
information.step2: Bend at your hips and knees to maintain a bent-over position, keeping your back straight.
information.step3: Pull the resistance band handles toward your lower ribcage, squeezing your shoulder blades.
information.step4: Slowly extend your arms, maintaining control as you return to the starting position. Keep a slight knee bend and engage your core.

information.step1: Step on the resistance band with both feet, shoulder-width apart.
information.step2: Hold the band's handles at shoulder height, palms inward, with elbows bent.
information.step3: Inhale and squat, keeping your back straight, chest up, and knees over toes.
information.step4: Exhale as you stand, pushing through your heels. Engage your core and maintain control.

information.step1: Sit on the bench with back support, anchoring the band securely.
information.step2: Grasp the handles at shoulder height, palms forward, and elbows bent.
information.step3: Exhale as you press the handles overhead.
information.step4: Inhale and lower the handles back down, maintaining control and core engagement.

information.step1: Sit on the bench with feet flat, anchoring the band under your feet.
information.step2: Grasp the band handles, palms facing each other, and arms slightly bent.
information.step3: Exhale and extend your arms out to the sides, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
information.step4: Inhale as you return to the starting position, maintaining core engagement.
